question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who underperformed their xG by the most (xG minus goals)?
answer: Darwin Núñez (Liverpool) underperformed his xG by the most among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024: 19.19 xG, 11 goals, for an xG minus goals of 8.19.
sql:
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.team_name, ', ' ORDER BY t.team_name) AS teams,
  SUM(COALESCE(pss.goals_pss, 0)) AS goals,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(pss.xg_pss, 0))::numeric, 2) AS xg,
  ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(pss.xg_pss, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(pss.goals_pss, 0)))::numeric, 2) AS xg_minus_goals
FROM player_season_stats pss
JOIN players p
  ON p.player_id = pss.player_id
JOIN teams t
  ON t.team_id = pss.team_id
JOIN seasons s
  ON s.season_id = pss.season_id
JOIN competitions c
  ON c.competition_id = s.competition_id
WHERE s.season = '2023-2024'
  AND c.league_code = 'ENG-PL'
GROUP BY
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(pss.goals_pss, 0)) >= 10
ORDER BY
  SUM(COALESCE(pss.xg_pss, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(pss.goals_pss, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 1;

out.notes: Use player_season_stats at player-team-season grain; join to seasons by season_id, competitions by competition_id, players by player_id, teams by team_id for display. Filter seasons.season = '2023-2024' and competitions.league_code = 'ENG-PL'. Aggregate by player_id across teams in case of in-season moves, then keep SUM(goals_pss) >= 10, compute SUM(xg_pss) - SUM(goals_pss), and order descending to find the largest xG underperformance.
